info.title: WetechiNetMon Incident API
info.description: Incident management REST API. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `error` code.

get.summary:
Every exporter seen in the last day: when it last reported, and its
rate over the last five minutes. Needs `traffic.read`, from the
traffic tenant only.

200.description: At most 1,000 exporters, by address

400.description: An unknown parameter

404.description: Traffic is not available to the caller's tenant

get.summary: The caller's tenant's incidents, newest first by default.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Repeatable. open, acknowledged, investigating, monitoring, recovering, resolved, closed.

parameters.name: opened_from
parameters.description: RFC 3339 UTC, inclusive. Needs `opened_to`; at most 90 days apart.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 1 to 200; default 50. Larger values are capped at 200.

parameters.name: include_total
parameters.description: `true` to count every match; charged twice against the read limit.

200.description: A page of incidents

400.description: An unknown parameter or value, a bad range or cursor

post.summary: Opens an incident by hand. Needs `incident.create`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 16 to 255 characters; a retry with the same key and body answers with the incident the first call opened

201.description: The incident opened, or on a replay the one the first call opened

400.description: Bad header or body, or an unknown field

409.description: An incident for the target is already active (its incident_id is given), the key was reused, or a limit is reached

422.description: The title, description or target is invalid

200.description: The incident

400.description: The id is not a UUID

404.description: No such incident in the caller's tenant

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 16 to 255 characters; a retry with the same key and body replays the first outcome

200.description: The incident after the change, or the current incident on a replay

400.description: Bad id, header or body, or an unknown field

404.description: No such incident in the caller's tenant

409.description: Version conflict, illegal transition, unchanged state or key reuse

get.summary:
An incident's notes. Bounded by the domain, so never paginated.
Notes an edit replaced are left out unless `include_superseded=true`.

parameters.name: include_superseded
parameters.description: Also return the notes an edit replaced. Defaults to false

200.description: The current notes, or every note with include_superseded

400.description: Bad id or an unknown parameter

404.description: No such incident in the caller's tenant

post.description:
Notes are append-only and cannot conflict, so neither
`expected_version` nor `Idempotency-Key` is required; a key, when
given, makes a retry replay instead of adding the note twice.

201.description: The incident with the note added, or the current incident on a replay

400.description: Bad id, header or body, or an unknown field

404.description: No such incident in the caller's tenant

409.description: The note limit is reached, or the key was reused

post.summary:
Replaces your own note with new text. Needs `incident.note.create`,
and the note must be yours.
post.description:
The original stays, marked superseded: `GET .../notes` shows the
replacement, and `include_superseded=true` shows both. A note is
replaced once; to change the text again, edit the replacement.

201.description: The incident with the replacement note added

400.description: Bad id, index, header or body, or an unknown field

403.description: The role lacks incident.note.create, or the note is someone else's

404.description: No such incident in the caller's tenant

409.description: The note limit is reached, or the key was reused

422.description: No such note, it was already replaced or redacted, or the text is too long

post.summary:
Removes a note's body, keeping the note and the record of who removed
it and why. Needs `incident.note.redact` (`noc_lead` and above).
post.description:
For words that must go, such as a pasted credential. A replaced note
can be redacted too. A note is redacted once.

200.description: The incident with the note redacted

400.description: Bad id, index, header or body, or an unknown field

404.description: No such incident in the caller's tenant

422.description: No such note, it is already redacted, or the reason is blank or too long

put.summary:
Sets one tag, replacing its value if the key exists. Needs
`incident.update`.
put.description:
`PUT` is idempotent by definition, so no `expected_version` is
required, and `Idempotency-Key` is optional.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The tag key, up to 64 characters

200.description: The incident with the tag set

400.description: Bad id, header or body, or an unknown field

404.description: No such incident in the caller's tenant

409.description: The tag limit is reached, or the key was reused

422.description: The key or value is too long

delete.summary:
Removes one tag. Removing a tag that is not set succeeds. Needs
`incident.update`.

200.description: The incident without the tag

400.description: Bad id or header

404.description: No such incident in the caller's tenant

get.summary:
The current session, so a reloaded page can learn its CSRF value.
Only a session cookie has one; a bearer token gets `404`.

200.description: The current session

404.description: The request was not made with a session

post.summary:
Signs in with an API token and answers with a session cookie. The
token goes in the body, never a header a proxy might log.

201.description: Signed in; the session cookie is set

400.description: A bad body or an unknown field

401.description: The token is unknown, expired or revoked

429.description: Too many failed sign-ins from this address

delete.summary:
Signs out: the session ends now, and the cookie is cleared. Needs the
CSRF header, like every cookie request that changes anything.

403.description: The CSRF header is missing or wrong

404.description: The request was not made with a session

get.summary:
Bits and packets per second over time, IPv4 and IPv6. Needs
`traffic.read`, from the traffic tenant only.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: RFC 3339 UTC; defaults to an hour before `to`

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: RFC 3339 UTC, exclusive; defaults to now. At most 30 days after `from`

200.description: At most 500 points

400.description: A bad range or an unknown parameter

404.description: Traffic is not available to the caller's tenant

get.summary:
The top talkers of one dimension, by bytes. Needs `traffic.read`, from
the traffic tenant only.

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: host, network, slash24, hostgroup, asn, interface or exporter

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: RFC 3339 UTC; defaults to an hour before `to`

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: RFC 3339 UTC, exclusive; defaults to now. At most 30 days after `from`

200.description: The top entries, largest first

400.description: An unknown dimension, a bad limit or range, or an unknown parameter

404.description: Traffic is not available to the caller's tenant

200.description: The caller

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up. Touches nothing else.

200.description: The process is running

get.summary: Readiness: the database answers. The API fails closed without it.

200.description: The database answers

address_family.description:
4 or 6. Taken from `target` when it is an address or network;
required for `hostgroup_total`.

oneOf.description: Defaults from the severity: critical P1, major P2, minor P3, info P4.

target.description: An address, a network in CIDR form, or a hostgroup name.

DetectionView.description: One detection event linked to the incident.

last_seen.description: When its traffic was last recorded, RFC 3339 UTC.

silent_seconds.description: Seconds since then. A large number means a silent exporter.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last.

incident_number.description: Per tenant and year, for example `WNM-2026-000123`.

mitigation_status.description: Always `none` in Phase 5: nothing is ever mitigated.

notification_status.description: Always `none` in Phase 5: nothing is ever notified.

policy_refs_omitted.description: Linked events whose policy was not recorded because the list is full.

state.description: open, acknowledged, investigating, monitoring, recovering, resolved, closed.

body.description: The replacement text. Untrusted, stored and returned verbatim.

reason.description: Required, up to 500 characters. Recorded on the audit trail.

body.description: Untrusted operator text, stored and returned verbatim.

Untrusted operator text, returned verbatim: escape it on output.
Empty once the note is redacted.

redacted.description: The body was removed. Who did it, and why, is on the audit trail.

superseded_by_note_index.description: The edit that replaced this note, if any.

supersedes_note_index.description: The note this one replaces, when it is an edit.

NoteVisibilityValue.description: Who may read a note. Only `internal` exists in Phase 5.

PolicyRefView.description: A detection policy that contributed to the incident.

ProblemDocument.description: RFC 9457 problem details, as every error response carries them.

type.description: `https://wetechi.com/probs/` and the code, as an identifier.

SessionView.description: The session, as the page needs it.

csrf_token.description: Send this in `X-WNM-CSRF` on every request that changes anything.

expires_at.description: When the session ends at the latest, RFC 3339 UTC.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: The session ends after this many seconds without a request.

SeverityRequest.description: `reason` is required when lowering severity, optional when raising it.

token.description:
An API token, `wnm_` and 64 hex characters. Used once, never stored
by the browser.

expires_at.description:
RFC 3339 UTC, in the future. Required: an indefinite suppression is
how a real attack gets missed.

TargetScope.description: What kind of target, in the detector's own vocabulary.

timeline_id.description: Increasing within the incident; also the paging cursor.

key.description:
The host, network (`address/length`), /24, hostgroup, ASN,
interface (`exporter/index/direction`) or exporter.

TrafficPoint.description:
One step of the summary. A step with no traffic is absent, not zero:
an absent point means no data arrived.

time.description: The start of the step, RFC 3339 UTC.

Truncation.description: Which sections were cut short at [`EXPORT_MAX_ROWS`].

VersionOnly.description: A transition that carries nothing but the version it expects.

expected_version.description: The incident's `version` as the caller last read it.

WhoAmI.description: The caller, as its token identifies it.

permissions.description: What the role grants, such as `incident.read`.

bearer.description: An API token, `wnm_` and 64 hex characters, from `wetechinetmon-api token create`.
